# LunarSight repository context

Read the repository-root `AGENTS.md`, then `docs/project-state.md`. Use `docs/README.md` to find task-relevant documents.

The current phase is a mock-data-first 3D web prototype in `web/` (user-authorized 13 November 2026; see `docs/decisions/0002-mock-first-3d-web.md`), in progress on branch `feat/3d-mock-viewer`. Do not acquire datasets, add processing/download scripts, CI jobs, or deployment manifests, and do not present mock values as real data without a later explicit authorization.

Data quantities, geographic scope, products, resolutions, hosting, and providers remain proposals unless recorded as accepted decisions. Do not invent commands or report unexecuted checks as passing; take web commands from `web/` once they exist and run them yourself.

Keep common project rules in `AGENTS.md`. Verify links, status consistency, source traceability, and the changed files. Update the current handoff when work changes the next step.
